description: Cadastral unit boundaries and data for downloading. Full dataset of entire Estonia. The data structure has changed (valid from 08.04.2024): the cadastral unit data no longer shows the way of formation, which is now located in the data of the boundary points.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: Row identifier of the GeoPackage feature table, added by the publisher's export.

table:columns.name: fid
table:columns.description: Second technical feature identifier of the publisher's export.

table:columns.name: tunnus
table:columns.description: Cadastral unit ID, the national cadastral code in the form 10501:001:0001.

table:columns.name: hkood
table:columns.description: Settlement ID (EHAK code of the settlement unit), four characters.

table:columns.name: mk_nimi
table:columns.description: County name.

table:columns.name: ov_nimi
table:columns.description: Municipality name.

table:columns.name: ay_nimi
table:columns.description: Settlements name.

table:columns.name: l_aadress
table:columns.description: Address (short address without municipality).

table:columns.name: registr
table:columns.description: Cadastral Unit registration date.

table:columns.name: muudet
table:columns.description: Cadastral Unit amendment date.

table:columns.name: siht1
table:columns.description: Intended use 1 (sihtotstarve), e.g. MAATULUNDUSMAA.

table:columns.name: siht2
table:columns.description: Intended use 2.

table:columns.name: siht3
table:columns.description: Intended use 3.

table:columns.name: so_prts1
table:columns.description: Intended use 1 percentage.

table:columns.name: so_prts2
table:columns.description: Intended use 2 percentage.

table:columns.name: so_prts3
table:columns.description: Intended use 3 percentage.

table:columns.name: pindala
table:columns.description: Area; the publisher states no unit, values match square metres.

table:columns.name: haritav
table:columns.description: Cultivated area; same unit as pindala.

table:columns.name: rohumaa
table:columns.description: Natural grassland area; same unit as pindala.

table:columns.name: mets
table:columns.description: Forest area; same unit as pindala.

table:columns.name: ouemaa
table:columns.description: Courtyard area; same unit as pindala.

table:columns.name: muumaa
table:columns.description: Other area; same unit as pindala.

table:columns.name: kinnistu
table:columns.description: Registered immovable number (land register).

table:columns.name: muutpohjus
table:columns.description: The last change of the Cadastral Unit.

table:columns.name: omvorm
table:columns.description: Ownership type.

table:columns.name: maks_hind
table:columns.description: Assessed value in euro.

table:columns.name: marked
table:columns.description: Cadastral Unit notations.

table:columns.name: ads_oid
table:columns.description: Address Data System (ADS) object identifier, identifies the object through versions.

table:columns.name: adob_id
table:columns.description: Unique identifier of the version of the Address Object (unique across all versions of all objects).

table:columns.name: oiguslik_alus
table:columns.description: The legal basis for the last change of the Cadastral Unit (the publisher's SHP table truncates this name to oiguslik_a; the GeoPackage carries the full name).

table:columns.name: eksport
table:columns.description: Extraction date of the file from the Land Cadastre.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry as a struct of xmin, ymin, xmax and ymax, added by the conversion.
